title: Sources: PE firm EQT is exploring a sale of Linux distribution vendor SUSE in a deal that could value it at up to $6B; SUSE was valued at ~$2.96B in 2023 (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: Sources: PE firm EQT is exploring a sale of Linux distribution vendor SUSE in a deal that could value it at up to $6B; SUSE was valued at ~$2.96B in 2023 — Private equity firm EQT AB (EQTAB.ST) is exploring a sale of open-source software company SUSE in a deal that could value it up to $6 billion …
